title: Whimsical Dragon Rollercoaster
description: A vibrant fantasy landscape features a large green dragon-shaped rollercoaster with red tracks winding across rolling green hills. The scene includes a traditional East Asian pagoda on a cliff with a waterfall, a blue winding river with wooden bridges, windmills, a fox-like creature peeking from a stone archway, and colorful lanterns illuminating paths under a pastel sky.
prompt: A vibrant whimsical fantasy landscape with a giant green dragon whose body forms a red-tracked rollercoaster winding over lush green hills. Traditional multi-tiered East Asian pagoda sits on a cliff beside a cascading waterfall. Blue river winds through the scene with wooden bridges, windmills, glowing lanterns, and a fox-like creature emerging from a stone tunnel. Pastel sky with clouds and kites, colorful flowers and mushrooms dot the terrain, storybook illustration style.
